name: 04-generic-us-music
statusMessage: Done: Spotify vs YouTube Music. 2 opportunities, 1 threats, 6 named issues. Open the Output tab for the battlecard.
verdict: Spotify's 26.6% negative share beats YouTube Music's 40.4%, but Spotify's own ad and crash complaints must be fixed before it can lead on rival weaknesses.
issues: Too many ads, especially for free users
App crashes, lags, or fails to load music
Forced Premium needed to skip or replay songs
Shuffle plays only part of playlist or repeats
Random songs or podcasts auto-played unexpectedly
